slides.headline: From messy call notes to a one-page offer.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: Long, vague, and no next step.
slides.right_sub: Make it easy to say yes.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Dump your notes
slides.card: Here are my notes from a client call: [paste]. Don't fix anything yet. Ask me what's missing.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Find the facts
slides.card: From these notes, list the client's problem, goal, budget and deadline. Mark anything unclear.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Draft the offer
slides.card: Draft an offer: scope, 2 price options, timeline. Use only facts from the notes.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: What's not included
slides.card: List 5 things this offer does not include, in plain words. Add 2 questions to confirm.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Cut to one page
slides.card: Cut the offer to one page. Then write a 4-line email with one clear next step.
slides.note: Read it before you send it.

scenes.headline: Late invoice? Don't write it tonight.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Write 3 payment reminders for invoice [nr], due [date], now [X] days late: friendly, clear, firm. Max 80 words each. Include the invoice number and amount. No threats.

scenes.title: 3 reminders, 3 tones
scenes.footer: Read it before you send it.

scenes.text: Save this for the next late invoice.
scenes.note: Check your payment terms. Keep private data out.
